authorization: 允许小补，不过根据你刚才的汇报，我观察到我们的skill似乎还有一点点问题，搜索参考文献的相关内容skill里是不是没有详细提及，我记得搜索文献找灵感在不少项目里都反复提及，但skill好像没有专门针对这个完善

rollback.strategy: Use the unchanged skills_v16/skills stable package; V16.1 is stored separately and does not overwrite V16 or existing projects.

changes: Interpret only proposed next_actions against current component state, decisions and evidence; preserve existing recovery classification.
Include implementation, verification, teammate reading/revision and delivery within a known real deadline; no automatic quality reduction.
Connect project planning and per-question candidate work to conditional literature orientation using existing semantic routes.
Explain exploratory literature search, adjacent-problem methods, original-source reading, idea adaptation and minimum distinguishing checks.
Separate inspiration from authority; do not assume same-year post-contest commentary or papers exist at contest startup.
preserved: All rules/*.json, route contracts, capability registry, state machine and project runtime protocols are byte-identical to stable V16.
All project execution, recovery, evidence and state scripts are byte-identical to stable V16.
Only release identity literals and release-report schema bindings change in three release driver scripts; underlying case logic is unchanged.
Existing tiers, human gates, evidence requirements, three release drivers and all 73 required case IDs are retained.
Inherited path-preflight tests retain every assertion; only temporary directory-alias fixture creation gains a Windows permission-compatible fallback.
release_authorization: 把这次小补迭代算作v16.1版本跟以前一样放入到总skill吧，它应该保有了绝大部分v16的能力，接下来的比赛我将会使用小补后的版本
release_identity_changes: Release-only policy/plan/state/manifest schema and driver report identity: 16.1; project runtime schema remains 16.0.
Historical preservation reviews retain their original V16.0.0-candidate review identity.
windows_test_fixture_adaptation: The inherited scenario fixture uses a real Windows directory junction only when directory symlink creation fails with WinError 1314; target resolution is checked, original assertions and required case IDs are unchanged, and the actual alias kind is reported.
